projectFormats.policy: One current project model with explicit feature tags. Current examples, presets and .premidi round trips retain routes and stable processor identities. Do not add hypothetical legacy migrations or embed recording audio.

presetStorage.scope: Current reusable Sound, Rack and processing-only presets preserve the same route model. Assets remain external.

routes.order: Stable route ID order for summation
sources: note velocity and key tracking for triggered Sounds
up to four named performance macros
routes.range: Each route explicitly selects unipolar or bipolar normalization
routes.depth: Signed depth in the destination's declared unit
routes.targets: src/dsp/parameters.js defines source-context targets; src/dsp/processor-automation.js derives every continuous post-effect control and mix from canonical fields. Stable processor IDs resolve to bounded native slots only during preparation.

combination.oscillatorDetune: Legacy pitch/bend/glide/vibrato base plus summed offset, bounded to +/-2400 cents before addition
combination.filterCutoff: Base frequency including legacy tone/sweep multiplied by 2^(summed octave offset bounded to +/-8); host applies its Nyquist limit
combination.postEffects: clamp(automated base + summed smoothed movement, canonical field minimum, maximum); stepped enable multiplies the resulting wet contribution

routes.normalization: Source normalization reserves potential oscillator level from level routes. Post-effect movement changes the selected field after source processing and pan.

timing.lfo: Hz or tempo division, authored phase and note/Clip restart or timeline clock. Timeline clocks revisit the same musical position during seek/loop. New post-effect sine routes use the direct authored cycle equation on both hosts.
timing.envelope: Independent linear ADSR with a 2 ms minimum attack, explicit note/Clip off and linear release toward 1e-6
timing.keyTracking: clamp((MIDI pitch-root)/span,-1,1), root and span explicit
timing.smoothing: Per-route first-order recurrence y[n]=alpha*x[n]+(1-alpha)*y[n-1], alpha=1-exp(-1/(sampleRate*seconds)); reset to zero at note-on
timing.web: Primary controls use audio-rate AudioParam/control signals. Post-effect movement uses prepared fixed-state worklet routes, with no per-frame storage allocation or UI timers.
timing.oracle: Graph control traces compared to portable mathematics at three rates: 0.02 cents pitch, 0.04 cents filter detune, 5e-6 gain/pan
timing.phase: Phase zero at the authored note-on, including the fractional interval before the first output sample in v2. Native timing does not depend on a host render quantum.
timing.browserOnset: Pitch-controlled v2 carriers silently pre-roll on a preceding boundary with an equal/opposite Fourier phase rotation. Recipe normalization stays fixed; source gains are muted until the authored note-on. See docs/native-onset-investigation.json.

automationAlignment.basePrecedence: Sound base -> matching timeline/captured source lane -> movement -> canonical parameter/device bounds
automationAlignment.implemented: Shared continuous post-effect controls, source amplitude/stereo/filter/oscillator targets and the authored lanes in docs/automation-contract.json
remaining: Further source/EQ/send targets and wider Track/game scopes
Monitored manual override/rejoin and follower/sidechain inputs

native.profile: Current C++ prepared voice transport and sample packet v27; sixteen routes, fixed per-voice state, strict kind/field/depth checks and no callback parsing/allocation
native.processing: Every post effect retains detector/delay history through mix/enable edits; dynamic rate integrates phase; carrier filters and tail reservation include authored movement bounds
native.qualification: Focused native/worklet PCM, seek continuity, independent macro reference and 48 kHz null-device streaming pass. Hardware performance and listening remain unqualified.

usability.basicControls: Cutoff, attack, release and volume remain unchanged and directly reachable
usability.advanced: One optional movement-routes section; amount/speed first, source/target/range available contextually

limitations: Delay/reverb sends, envelope follower and selectable audio sidechains remain unfinished
Reference-hardware performance at maximum route and voice counts remains unqualified
Musical polish, physical Windows audio/microphone and newcomer comprehension require observed review
Previous stress capture paused the audio clock during preparation and does not establish interactive startup performance

gameCompatibility.policy: Target the current pre-programmed reader contract. No silent downgrade, hypothetical old readers or required WAV conversion. No current cross-repository implementation audit was performed.
